description: This Ruby script generates Markdown documentation for Redis Modules API by parsing C source code comments and function definitions in 'module.c'. It extracts documentation comments, function prototypes, and builds an index of exported functions, producing a structured API reference.

methods.name: markdown
methods.description: Converts C comments to Markdown format, fixing syntax and linking function names.

methods.name: linebreak_proto
methods.description: Breaks long function prototypes into multiple lines for readability.

methods.name: docufy
methods.description: Extracts documentation for exported functions and outputs Markdown documentation.

methods.name: section_doc
methods.description: Outputs Markdown documentation for section comments.

methods.name: section_name_to_id
methods.description: Generates URL-friendly IDs for section links.

methods.name: get_section_heading
methods.description: Extracts section heading names from comments.

methods.name: is_section_doc
methods.description: Determines if a line starts a documentation section.

methods.name: is_func_line
methods.description: Checks if a line contains a function definition starting with RM_.
